summary: This directory contains integration and live tests for Vercel AI provider functionalities, focusing on verifying model execution, service operations, and retry mechanisms within real-world execution environments.
responsibilities: Validating model execution against the Vercel AI provider
Testing integration of retry logic within provider communication
relationships: Retry mechanisms are tested in conjunction with Vercel AI service calls to ensure reliability.
Model execution tests verify the communication interface between the application and the Vercel AI provider.
designDecisions: Isolation of integration tests into a dedicated directory
Focus on end-to-end verification of provider-specific features
Separation of live testing concerns from core implementation
